learning_outcomes.text: Ability to solve problems with initiative, decision-making, creativity, critical reasoning, and to communicate and transmit knowledge, skills, and abilities in the field of Industrial Engineering.
Knowledge for performing measurements, calculations, valuations, appraisals, expert opinions, studies, reports, work plans, and other similar tasks.
Ability to handle specifications, regulations, and mandatory standards.
Ability to organize and plan within the company, and other institutions and organizations.
Ability to work in a multilingual and multidisciplinary environment.
Knowledge, understanding, and ability to apply the necessary legislation in the exercise of the profession of Industrial Technical Engineer.
Possess a historical-social culture and aesthetic sensitivity.

Ability to apply knowledge about occupational health and safety, prevention of occupational risks, and machine safety, according to current regulations on passive and active fire protection, and aspects of acoustic pollution.
Knowledge and capacities to organize and manage projects. Know the organizational structure and functions of a project office.

Ability for the drafting, signing, and development of projects in the field of industrial engineering whose objective is: the construction, reform, repair, conservation, demolition, manufacturing, installation, assembly, or operation of: structures, mechanical equipment, energy installations, electrical and electronic installations, industrial installations and plants, and manufacturing and automation processes.
Ability for the direction of the activities subject to the engineering projects described in competence 61.
Demonstrate awareness of respect for diversity and the principles of universal accessibility and design for all people.
Contribute to the design, development and execution of solutions that respond to social demands, taking the Sustainable Development Goals as a reference.
Function effectively in a team whose members together provide leadership and create a collaborative and inclusive environment in the organization and coordination of work.
Identify the roles and skills to operate in multidisciplinary teams with different professional profiles.
Collaborate proactively in the development of work, establishing goals and meeting objectives.
Contribute to the search for solutions to challenges or projects, demonstrating empathy and assertiveness when sharing ideas, reflections, and arguments within collaborative work.
Structure discourse to facilitate understanding of the objectives, actions, and/or results of one's own work.
Develop professional texts or scientific-technical reports according to the conventions of the discipline.

syllabus_topics: The Technical Office: The Technical Office as a department of a company.
Free exercise of the profession. Professional associations.
1. The Project: Concept, types and methodology.
The Industrial Project and its phases.
2. Legal and administrative aspects of the industrial project.
Other studies: Occupational health and safety; Prevention of occupational risks and machine safety; Fire protection; Acoustic and environmental pollution.
4. Project management / Specific aspects of projects.
teaching_methods: Individual and group preparation of essays, problem-solving, projects
Student self-study (preparation for readings, exams, exercises, classes)
assessment_rules: The final grade (N_F) is calculated as 0.5 * N_PE + 0.30 * N_PR + 0.20 * N_OB, where N_PE is written tests, N_PR is practical tests, and N_OB is observation. The course is approved if N_F is 5 or higher, and N_PE, N_PR, and N_OB are all 4 or higher. If N_PE, N_PR, or N_OB is below 4, the course is failed, and the final grade is capped at a maximum of 4. In the second call, students can retake the failed part, and previously passed parts' grades will be respected. Failure to submit the written test, all practicals, or the final project results in a 'No Presentado' grade.
bibliography: NORMATIVA Y LEGISLACIÓN APLICABLE A PROYECTOS: In general, the regulations and legislation are very extensive, with one or another being applicable depending on the type of project carried out. These will be introduced throughout the course. To stay updated, it is recommended to visit institutions and companies that offer information on the subject: Boletin Oficial del Estado, Boletín Oficial de la Provincia de Valencia, Ministerio de Energía y Turismo, Ministerio de Agricultura, Alimentación y Medio ambiente, Colegio Oficial de Ingenieros Técnicos Industriales y de Grado de Valencia.
Libro: Oficina Técnica y Proyectos. de la UPV de: Brusola Simón, Fernando.
